import os, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
os.chdir("/agent/jobs/b4cc24f7-7d34-4678-9427-998ab6e19307/provenance")
m=pd.read_csv("PHD_master_table.csv"); cav=json.load(open("cavity_and_interfaces.json"))
cat=pd.read_csv("catalytic_residue_mapping.csv"); cat=cat[cat.ref=="LPOg"].set_index("site")
labels=[s for s in ["distal Gln","ester Asp","distal His","ester Glu","prox-side Arg","proximal His"] if s in cat.index]
print("labels used:",labels)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,9))
cell=[[cat.ref_res[l], cat.CeBLI3[l], cat.hDUOX1[l], cat.hDUOX2[l]] for l in labels]
col=[["#cfe8cf", ("#cfe8cf" if cat.conserved_in_BLI3[l] else "#f6d5d5"), "#f6d5d5","#f6d5d5"] for l in labels]
ax[0,0].axis("off")
t=ax[0,0].table(cellText=cell,rowLabels=labels,
                colLabels=["lactoperoxidase","C. elegans BLI-3","human DUOX1","human DUOX2"],
                cellColours=col, loc="center", cellLoc="center")
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(10); t.scale(1,1.6)
ax[0,0].set_title("A  Heme ligand and covalent ester positions transferred from lactoperoxidase\n(green retained, red substituted)",fontsize=11,loc="left")

groups=[("non-interface\nsurface", m[(m.rsa_alone>0.20)&(~m.iface_any)].pct_id),
        ("DUOX1 TM/NOX\nmodule", m[(m.rsa_alone>0.20)&(m.d_TMNOX<4.5)].pct_id),
        ("DUOXA1\n(cis)", m[(m.rsa_alone>0.20)&(m.d_DUOXA1_B<4.5)].pct_id),
        ("DUOXA1\n(trans)", m[(m.rsa_alone>0.20)&(m.d_DUOXA1_D<4.5)].pct_id),
        ("DUOX1 other\nprotomer", m[(m.rsa_alone>0.20)&(m.d_DUOX1_C<4.5)].pct_id)]
data=[g[1].dropna().values for g in groups]
bp=ax[0,1].boxplot(data,labels=[g[0] for g in groups],showmeans=True,widths=0.6,patch_artist=True)
for i,b in enumerate(bp['boxes']): b.set_facecolor("#dddddd" if i==0 else "#9ecae1")
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for i,d in enumerate(data): ax[0,1].scatter(rng.normal(i+1,0.07,len(d)),d,s=7,alpha=.5,color="k",zorder=3)
for i,(lab,s) in enumerate(groups[1:],start=2):
    p=stats.mannwhitneyu(s.dropna(),data[0],alternative="greater")[1]
    ax[0,1].text(i,1.06,"p=%.1g"%p,ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[0,1].set_ylim(-0.05,1.15); ax[0,1].set_ylabel("fraction identical, 150 vertebrate DUOX1/DUOX2")
ax[0,1].set_title("B  Surface conservation of the PHD by interface partner (7D3F)",fontsize=11,loc="left")

Pk=m[m.pocket].pct_id.dropna(); Bur=m[(m.rsa_alone<0.10)&(~m.pocket)].pct_id.dropna()
ax[1,0].boxplot([Pk.values,Bur.values],labels=["vestigial heme\npocket (n=%d)"%len(Pk),
                "other buried\nresidues (n=%d)"%len(Bur)],showmeans=True,widths=0.5,patch_artist=True)
ax[1,0].scatter(rng.normal(1,0.06,len(Pk)),Pk,s=10,color="k",alpha=.6)
ax[1,0].set_ylabel("fraction identical")
p=stats.mannwhitneyu(Pk,Bur,alternative="two-sided")[1]
ax[1,0].set_title("C  Vestigial heme pocket is less conserved than the rest of\nthe PHD core (Mann-Whitney p=%.3g); cavity shrunk to %d%% of LPO"%(p,100*cav["cavity_DUOX1_A3"]/cav["cavity_LPO_A3"]),fontsize=11,loc="left")
ax2=ax[1,0].twinx()
ax2.bar([1.55,2.35],[cav["cavity_LPO_A3"],cav["cavity_DUOX1_A3"]],width=0.18,color=["#e6550d","#3182bd"],alpha=.35)
ax2.set_ylabel("free volume within 9 A of heme Fe position (A^3)")
ax2.text(1.55,cav["cavity_LPO_A3"]+12,"LPO %d"%cav["cavity_LPO_A3"],ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax2.text(2.35,cav["cavity_DUOX1_A3"]+12,"DUOX1 %d"%cav["cavity_DUOX1_A3"],ha="center",fontsize=8)

ax[1,1].plot(m.resi,m.pct_id.rolling(5,center=True).mean(),lw=0.9,color="#333333")
for c,cc,lab,y in [("d_TMNOX","#31a354","TM/NOX module",1.04),("d_DUOXA1_B","#3182bd","DUOXA1 cis",1.08),
                   ("d_DUOXA1_D","#9ecae1","DUOXA1 trans",1.12)]:
    s=m[m[c]<4.5]; ax[1,1].scatter(s.resi,[y]*len(s),s=14,color=cc,label=lab,marker="|")
pk=m[m.pocket]; ax[1,1].scatter(pk.resi,[1.16]*len(pk),s=16,color="#e6550d",marker="|",label="vestigial heme pocket")
ax[1,1].set_xlabel("human DUOX1 residue"); ax[1,1].set_ylabel("conservation (5-residue mean)")
ax[1,1].legend(fontsize=8,ncol=2,loc="lower center"); ax[1,1].set_ylim(0,1.22)
ax[1,1].set_title("D  Conservation along the PHD with interface and pocket positions",fontsize=11,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
